sources.title: IEM archived NBS 06 UTC forecast for Midway
sources.excerpt: September 16 06 UTC run gives September 17 daytime maximum TXN 78°F and XND 3°F, reported at September 18 00 UTC.

sources.title: NOAA NBM station card definitions
sources.excerpt: NBS maximum TXN spans 12 UTC through following-day 06 UTC and is reported at following-day 00 UTC. XND is the maximum/minimum temperature standard deviation in Fahrenheit.

findings.claim: At the next-day horizon the frozen NBS forecast is 78°F with a 3°F reported model standard deviation. XND is model uncertainty, not independently demonstrated error calibration.

limitations: Initialization time is not an exact publication timestamp. Retrieval times use conservative bundle capture time.
NBS daytime maximum and IEM station daily maximum remain proxies for TWC settlement.
